mapper.select:
SELECT p.code, p.name, p.spec, p.storage,
(SELECT i.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'STORAGE_METHOD' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = p.storage LIMIT 1) AS storage_nm,
p.client_code, (SELECT c.name FROM clients c WHERE c.client_code = p.client_code LIMIT 1) AS client_name, COALESCE(p.discontinued, 0) AS discontinued, p.discontinued_at, p.discontinued_by, p.discontinued_note, COALESCE(p.stock_qty, 0) AS stock_qty,
p.reg_user_id, COALESCE(re.name, p.reg_user_id) AS reg_user_nm, TO_CHAR(p.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_dt, p.upd_user_id, COALESCE(ue.name, p.upd_user_id) AS upd_user_nm, TO_CHAR(p.upd_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS upd_dt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bom b WHERE b.product_code = p.code) AS material_count, (SELECT MAX(s.schedule_date) FROM production_schedule s WHERE s.product_code = p.code AND s.actual_qty IS NOT NULL AND s.actual_qty != '') AS last_produced_date FROM products p LEFT JOIN employees re ON re.id = p.reg_user_id LEFT JOIN employees ue ON ue.id = p.upd_user_id
WHERE COALESCE(p.discontinued, 0) = 0
ORDER BY p.code

SELECT code, name,
client_code, (SELECT c.name FROM clients c WHERE c.client_code = products.client_code LIMIT 1) AS client_name, COALESCE(stock_qty, 0) AS stock_qty FROM products WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET upd_user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT b.material_code, COALESCE(m.name, b.material_name) AS material_name, b.ratio_percent, b.unit_price_per_kg, b.amount_per_kg, b.rank_in_product FROM bom b LEFT JOIN materials m ON m.code = b.material_code WHERE b.product_code = #{code} ORDER BY b.rank_in_product
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bom ( product_code, material_code, material_name, ratio_percent, unit_price_per_kg, amount_per_kg, rank_in_product ) VALUES ( #{code}, #{line.materialCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{line.materialName}, #{line.ratioPercent, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{line.unitPricePerKg, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{line.amountPerKg, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{line.rank} )
mapper.select: SELECT loss_cost AS "lossCost", markup_cost AS "markupCost", labor_cost AS "laborCost", packaging_cost AS "packagingCost", logistics_cost AS "logisticsCost", margin AS "margin", other_cost1 AS "otherCost1", other_cost2 AS "otherCost2", other_cost3 AS "otherCost3", other_cost4 AS "otherCost4" FROM pricing WHERE product_code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bom_change_log ( product_code, changed_at, old_bom_json, new_bom_json ) VALUES ( #{code}, #{changedAt}, #{oldBomJson}, #{newBomJson} )
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "logId", changed_at AS "changedAt", old_bom_json AS "oldBomJson", new_bom_json AS "newBomJson" FROM bom_change_log WHERE product_code = #{code} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT p.pouch_net_weight_kg AS "pouchNetWeightKg", p.pouch_length_m AS "pouchLengthM", p.pouch_per_unit AS "pouchPerUnit", p.film_material_code AS "filmMaterialCode", p.pouch_material_code AS "pouchMaterialCode", p.box_material_code AS "boxMaterialCode", f.name AS "filmMaterialName", o.name AS "pouchMaterialName", x.name AS "boxMaterialName" FROM products p LEFT JOIN materials f ON f.code = p.film_material_code LEFT JOIN materials o ON o.code = p.pouch_material_code LEFT JOIN materials x ON x.code = p.box_material_code WHERE p.code = #{code}
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET pouch_net_weight_kg = #{sub.pouchNetWeightKg, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, pouch_length_m = #{sub.pouchLengthM, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, pouch_per_unit = #{sub.pouchPerUnit, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, film_material_code = #{sub.filmMaterialCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, pouch_material_code = #{sub.pouchMaterialCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, box_material_code = #{sub.boxMaterialCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT code, name, unit_price, sub_category, (SELECT split_part(i.item_nm, ' — ', 1) FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'SUB_MATERIAL_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = sub_category LIMIT 1) AS sub_category_nm FROM materials WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY name

SELECT code, name, unit_price, sub_category, (SELECT split_part(i.item_nm, ' — ', 1) FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'SUB_MATERIAL_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = sub_category LIMIT 1) AS sub_category_nm FROM materials WHERE name = #{name} ORDER BY CASE WHEN code = #{preferCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, code LIMIT 1

SELECT code, name, unit_price, sub_category, (SELECT split_part(i.item_nm, ' — ', 1) FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'SUB_MATERIAL_CATEGORY' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = sub_category LIMIT 1) AS sub_category_nm FROM materials WHERE code = #{value} OR name = #{value} ORDER BY CASE WHEN code = #{value} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

SELECT i.item_code FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'STORAGE_METHOD' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE COALESCE(i.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(g.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.item_code
SELECT name FROM clients WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY name
SELECT client_code AS "clientCode", name AS "name" FROM clients WHERE client_code IS NOT NULL AND name IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY name
SELECT client_code FROM clients WHERE client_code = #{clientCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT client_code FROM clients WHERE client_code = #{clientCode} AND COALESCE(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' LIMIT 1
SELECT name FROM clients WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
